units.source_text: “‘纸糊大石轻飘飘，腹中无物是草包’，据说那时候京都还流传这首打油诗。

en.t: It is said that in Kyoto at the time, this comic verse was still being passed around:
“A paper-covered Oishi floats light as air; with nothing in his belly, he is only a straw sack.”

units.source_text: 如果不是巧妙做事，根本不可能欺骗天下百姓到这个程度。

en.t: Only by handling matters with such skill could he have deceived the people of the realm to this extent.

units.source_text: 早些时候天野弥左卫门官人对您的勇敢沉着大加褒奖，是十分准确的。”

en.t: When Lord Amano Yazaemon praised your courage and composure a little while ago, his judgment was entirely accurate.
